title: Mohammad R NDE 9924
content: I went to the medical clinic with my 12-year-old son and 8-year-old daughter for a checkup. My son took his test. As I was holding my daughter for her test, my body became very hot. I felt very weak and couldn't walk. So I asked my son for a wafer. Then I lost consciousness. Then I entered a very relaxing space with colors similar to green and orange. I realized the presence of my deceased friend, from 20 years ago, who was by my side. I was on a winding, mountain road that I went up a bit. As we walked, I was told that I should go back for the sake of my children since I am raising my children alone. Suddenly, I opened my eyes and saw a nurse hitting me in the face. She was saying, 'You are good, sir.' I felt a very heavy pressure on my shoulders. I was really sad with all my being. But when I saw my worried children, I hugged them and calmed down. I tried to tell a few people, but most of them didn't believe me. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 12/15/2022 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain When taking blood from my child, there was a sharp drop in blood pressure and fainting, and the whites of the eyes appeared Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal Yes, it was much more complete. Of course, I could understand the presence or the conversations that happened to me, and it was not necessary to see visually and hear with my ears. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Physically, until the moment I put the wafer in my mouth. But in terms of perception, I was completely alert Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I didn't notice the passage of time at all because the words and events must have lasted for several hours, but according to my child and the nurse, between six and ten minutes I was in that state where the blackness of my eyes was gone and the whites were visible. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could see the nature and surroundings, but I understood my companion and those who were talking to me Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I had almost no hearing, only the understanding of sounds Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes My friend was a student when we developed a deep spiritual connection and she died due to an accident and I buried her myself, but I still think about her completely and I love her. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Full light that did not hurt the eyes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm A bright space with colors that I don't know what they are and I don't have a name for them, combinations of green and orange And indescribable silence and peace What emotions did you feel during the experience? Pure peace, ease of imagination I am not an emotional person at all and I cannot express my feelings Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others It proved to me that I have chosen the right path and moved Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Muslim Are you a Muslim of the Shia religion? Of course, I have believed in the equality of religions for many years, but I fulfill religious obligations according to Islam and the Shia religion. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes Religion is an excuse and there is no need to perform religious rituals What is your religion now? Muslim Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I already believed in the part of peace after death and ease of death But the way creatures communicate through perception was not digestible for me and it was new Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin My deceased friend who was with me the whole way And there were some people who passionately told me that you should go back and raise your children Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes We will all reach peace and there is no hell or heaven During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Uncertain I did not receive evidence because I have always believed in the existence of a higher power called God Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes The goal is love and recognition During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes Everything there was love and affection and friendship What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life I am kinder and have a more purposeful life and less greed Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? I have become kinder and I don't take life hard Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes The colors I saw and the soothing and sure feeling I had are indescribable How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I have already said that the power of communication is perception Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared a day or two after the incident I got mostly negative feedback and some people tried to give a scientific reason that I am talking nonsense Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes In terms of my own existential philosophy, I was looking for it and I read several books, including the world after death and evidence of the existence of life after death and… What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely not real It was and is completely clear and obvious to me. These were my beliefs What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely not real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Uncertain Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No gdlta8c_nde

arrival.other_being_detail: He reported the presence of his deceased friend, and also "some people" who told him to go back and raise his children.

environment.environment_other_detail: A "very relaxing space" with "combinations of green and orange"; "full light that did not hurt the eyes"; "indescribable silence and peace"; a "winding, mountain road" that he went up a bit.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: He fainted during his child's blood draw/checkup; he described a sharp drop in blood pressure and loss of consciousness.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Shia (fulfills religious obligations according to Islam and the Shia religion; also stated belief in equality of religions).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He described being on a winding mountain road and being told to return for his children; he did not report a tunnel or life review.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He lost consciousness, entered a relaxing colored space/realm, was with his deceased friend and walked up a winding mountain road, encountered a barrier he could not cross and was told to return, then abruptly woke to a nurse hitting his face.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He emphasized communication via perception rather than normal hearing/vision, and described being on a winding mountain road in the unearthly realm.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: A "bright space with colors that I don't know what they are" (combinations of green and orange) with "indescribable silence and peace." He was told to "go back for the sake of my children."
